_comment: RPG Magic System Schema: Integrates 6 Elements (Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Light, Dark) across 6 Arcane Schools (Destruction, Restoration, Alteration, Conjuration, Illusion, Mysticism). Fully compliant with FDynamicAbilityDef, FDynamicDeliveryArchetype, sequential BaseSpellTier charging, GASP PhysicsControl profiles, and SourcePassBackRules[cite: 4].

ReplicatedEntries.Value: Launches a focused bolt of elemental fire. Overcharging evolves the spell into adetonating Fireball.
Tier 1 Destruction [Fire]. Hold to charge into Tier 2 Fireball.
Hurls an explosive sphere of flame that detonates on impact, knocking ragdolls back. Can be charged further into Meteor Swarm.
Tier 2 Destruction [Fire]. Evolved from Firebolt; charges into Tier 3 Meteor Swarm.
Unleashes a cataclysmic salvo of five blazing meteors that home in on targets and shatter posture.
Tier 3 Destruction [Fire]. Fires 5 homing meteors with high ragdoll break impulse.
Discharges a high-voltage arc of ionized air that leaps between up to 5 nearby enemies.
Tier 1 Destruction [Air]. Bounces up to 5 targets within 650m with 20% falloff per jump.
Flash-freezes the moisture around the caster in an instantaneous ring, blasting enemies back and stiffening their ragdoll limb motors.
Tier 1 Destruction [Water]. Instantaneous server sweep shockwave around caster.
Consecrates the ground around the caster with a pulsing golden aura that continuously restores Health and Stamina.
Tier 1 Restoration [Light]. Pulsing aura that heals +20 Health every 0.5s.
Surrounds the caster in a soothing veil of elemental water that continuously regenerates limb integrity.
Tier 1 Restoration [Water]. Constant rate healing (+25 Health/sec) while inside the aura.
Hardens the caster's skin and ragdoll joints with living granite, passively increasing Strength and physical impact resistance.
Tier 1 Alteration [Earth]. Grants +30 Strength while active, stiffening GASP limb motors against ragdoll knockdowns.
Channels a resonant pulse of transmutative earth magic into a locked door or chest, unsealing its tumblers and swinging it open.
Tier 1 Alteration [Earth]. Unlocks and opens locked doors within 4.5 meters.
Conjures a contracting rift of dark gravity at a target point, crushing nearby enemies inward and draining their endurance.
Tier 1 Conjuration [Dark]. Stationary contracting sphere that deals periodic dark damage and physics implosion.
Dissolves the caster into a shimmering mirage of wind and refracted light, surging forward at blinding velocity.
Tier 1 Illusion [Air]. High-velocity GASP movement dash.
Projects an unseen wave of psychic air pressure to hurl moveable world objects or doors away from the caster.
Tier 1 Mysticism [Air]. Chargeable telekinetic push that scales physical impulse with charge duration.
Projects an expanding and contracting ring of umbral mysticism that drains life force from enemies and passes Vitality directly back to the caster.
Tier 1 Mysticism [Dark]. Oscillating aura that drains enemy Health and heals the caster via SourcePassBackRules.
